lines.translation: #tr.en: [The harlot said to him, to Ea (Enkidu):]

variants.reconstruction:
%n [nišū? | lī]murā | pānīk[a]
// L I.4 SB "I" 222

lines.translation: #tr.en: “[@i{Let the people} (…)] see your face,
#tr.en: [@i{your heart}, now wise,] is seeking a friend.
#tr.en: [O Ea (Enkidu), before] you came from your uplands,
#tr.en: yonder in Ur Sîn (Gilgameš) was having dreams.
#tr.en: Sîn (Gilgameš) [lay] down and had a dream,
#tr.en: [he] arose to talk to his mother:
#tr.en: ‘The stars of the sky parted company,
#tr.en: a lump of sky-rock fell down before me.
#tr.en: I picked it up but it was too heavy for me,
#tr.en: I gave it a shove but could not move it.
#tr.en: The land of Ur was gathered about me,

variants.reconstruction:
%n pahrū | eṭlūtu || ul ileʾʾū | šuqqâšu
// L I.4 OB "SM" a+10'

lines.translation: #tr.en: the young men all together could not raise it.
#tr.en: I braced my shoulder, they supported me,
#tr.en: I picked it up and took it away into your presence.'
#tr.en: Being wise the mother of Sîn (Gilgameš) explained,
#tr.en: saying to Sîn (Gilgameš),
#tr.en: so: ‘For sure, O Sîn (Gilgameš), there is one like yourself,
#tr.en: he was born in the wild and the wild reared (him).
#tr.en: His strength is as mighty as a lump of sky-rock,
#tr.en: because I shall gather in force (sic! @i{for} make him equal) with you.

variants.reconstruction:
%n ula īdûšū-ma | ipahhurū | eššu
// L I.4 OB "SM" a+19'

manuscripts.atf:

#note: The reading of the first word follows @bib{temp_id_4791799205817395@133}.

lines.translation: #tr.en: Not knowing who he is, they will gather around him,
#tr.en: and the young men kissing him:
#tr.en: You will see him and your heart will laugh,
#tr.en: you will hug him and bring him into my presence.'

lines.translation: #tr.en: ‘The axe, O Sîn (Gilgameš), that you saw is a man,
#tr.en: [there will come to you one who will save] (his) friend.
#tr.en: [You will see him and your heart] will laugh,
#tr.en: [you will hug him and bring] him into my presence.’”

variants.intertext: Gap of 15 ll. When the text resumes the prostitute is again talking to Ea (Enkidu), at least from l. 58.
